No. 190/ CDOE/Geo Date: 30.10.2024
Advertisement
Applications are invited for the post of one research assistant and two field investigators (purely on
temporary/contract basis) under the Punjab Government funded project entitled “Social Impact Assessment
Study for the Construction of Minor 9 of Bhawanigarh Distributary (canal), Tehsil: Bhawanigarh,
District: Sangrur, Punjab” in the Department of Geography, Centre for Distance and Online Education,
Panjab University, Chandigarh as per details given below:
Sr. No. Position Edu. Qualification Emoluments Duration
1. Research Assistant
(One Post)
Post graduate in social science
discipline (55% minimum) with NET
/M.Phil. / Ph.D.
Desirable: Proficiency in Punjabi
language (both written and spoken)
Rs. 37, 000/-
p.m. fixed
3* Months
2. Field Investigators
(Two Posts)
Post graduate in social science
discipline with minimum 55% marks.
Desirable: Proficiency in Punjabi
language (both written and spoken)
Rs. 20, 000/-
p.m. fixed
3* Months
Note*: The tenure may be extended up to 1 year. The selected candidate will have to join immediately.
Interested candidates who fulfill the above conditions may send their applications in the prescribed format
along with CV at email: suchasahota@gmail.com on or before 06th November, 2024. The detail of interview
will be communicated to the shortlisted candidates by e-mail.
-Sd-
Dr. Sucha Singh
(Project Investigator)
Coordinator & Assistant Professor
Department of Geography,
Centre for Distance and Online Education,
Panjab University, Chandigarh-160014
